title: Menu Layout Continuity
description: Four reference-linked menu mockups establishing a consistent cover-and-spread food system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the cover geometry, print materials, placeholder text grammar, and food-image cadence. Images 02-04 preserve that exact menu system while rotating section emphasis and spread structure.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-cover-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
